title: Handley Page Halifax's JP201 and LL137
memorial_details:
Four incised tablets bearing inscriptions and names, attached to a granite Stone of Remembrance. Memorial stone is bordered by a small gravelled area, enclosed by low kerbstones. Adjacent, is the Village War Memorial, IWM ref. 25327

This memorial was erected to their honour on November 6th 1994
inscription: Tablet, top : IN MEMORY / OF THE CREWS OF TWO HALIFAX AIRCRAFT WHICH COLLIDED / OVER THIS PARISH ON THE NIGHT OF 15th NOVEMBER 1944 Tablet, centre left : CREW OF HALIFAX JP201 / (5 NAMES) / (1 NAME) WAS THE ONLY / SURVIVOR, HE IS LISTED AS " MISSING " ON / 18. 4. 45 WHILE FLYING ON OPERATIONS Tablet, centre right : CREW OF HALIFAX LL137 / (8 NAMES) Tablet, bottom : THIS MEMORIAL WAS ERECTED TO THEIR HONOUR ON NOVEMBER 6th 1994
